module.name: require-error-cause
module.description: Keep the original exception when throwing a replacement error.

scenarios.name: should allow reading a cause through asserted options
scenarios.given: try { work(); } catch (error) { const options = { cause: error }; const original = options!.cause; throw new Error("failed", options); }
scenarios.when: the rule analyzes the fixture with default options
scenarios.then: no diagnostic is reported

scenarios.name: should preserve angle asserted cause
scenarios.given: try { run(); } catch (error) { throw new Error("failed", { cause: <unknown>error }); }
scenarios.when: the rule analyzes the fixture with default options
scenarios.then: no diagnostic is reported

scenarios.name: should preserve nonnull cause
scenarios.given: try { run(); } catch (error) { throw new Error("failed", { cause: error! }); }
scenarios.when: the rule analyzes the fixture with default options
scenarios.then: no diagnostic is reported

scenarios.name: should preserve nested satisfies cause
scenarios.given: try { run(); } catch (error) { throw new Error("failed", { cause: (error as unknown) satisfies unknown }); }

scenarios.then: no diagnostic is reported

scenarios.name: should preserve computed static cause key

scenarios.then: no diagnostic is reported

scenarios.name: should preserve aliases captured before reassignment
scenarios.given: try { run(); } catch (error) { const original = error; error = other; throw new Error("failed", { cause: original }); }

scenarios.then: no diagnostic is reported

scenarios.name: should reject overwritten cause through asserted receiver

scenarios.when: the rule analyzes the fixture with default options
scenarios.then: the expected diagnostic is reported: [{ messageId: 'missingCause' }]
